prompt:

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.rationale: A past-tense verb breaks the pattern set by the first two items.
Correct. After 'learned to,' the series continues with base verbs.
An -ing phrase breaks the pattern of base verbs.
Repeating 'to' only on the last item breaks the pattern 'to a, b, and c'.

explanation: Items in a series must share one grammatical form; match the third item to the first two.
